records.title: 10-K
records.text: Net revenue for the year ended December 31, 2021 increased $125.4 million, or 12.3%, compared to the year ended December 31, 2020 with higher volumes accounting for approximately seven percentage points of the annual growth.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Sweet baked goods revenue increased $105.1 million or 11.4% due to higher volume in Convenience, Grocery and Dollar channels, the benefit of pricing actions implemented in the second half of the year and continued momentum of single-serve products driving favorable product mix.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: During the second half of 2020 and all of 2021, we have continued to experience strong demand in our multi-pack products, as well as an increase in our immediate consumption single-serve business as mobility increased.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: During the years ended December 31, 2021 and 2020, there were fluctuations in the market price of our publicly traded warrants.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Operating income for the year ended December 31, 2021 was $200.7 million compared to $135.3 million for the year ended December 31, 2020.
